clauses.title: A successful cleanup result is the terminal workspace evidence
requires: return createResult('workspace_cleanup', { removed: true, path: actual.path, terminalHead: actual.head, terminalTree: actual.tree, id: receipt.id, retainedRoot });

clauses.title: The record states what follows a removal
requires: no `workspace_*` operation may target the removed path afterwards
the terminal recheck after removal is operator-side only
caller error, never evidence about the target

clauses.title: Cleanup-terminal fixtures pin the prose and the returned evidence
requires: the cleanup result is named terminal and post-removal workspace calls are forbidden
the cleanup operation already returns the terminal evidence it is now named for
